page.overview:
Who is Fu Hong?

Born on independent Jasmine Island into the Fu family, Fu Hong strove to assist the clan's business in tea making. However, the Fu family's old economic power was in decline by the 1st century BG, with both local as well as foreign competition reducing their influence. Determined to halt this development, Fu Hong eventually began to resort to smuggling and black market trading, covertly selling tea, including the unique golden jasmine tea, to the Earth Kingdom and falsifying records to make a profit. The resulting money and influence enabled him to win an election campaign for the Jasmine Island Council, and he was desperate to keep this position whatever it took. On the council, he represented the island's traditional tea traders.

Ultimately, Fu Hong's illegal activities were discovered by Magistrate Emerald, the Earth Kingdom's civilian representative on Jasmine Island. The magistrate threatened to expose Fu Hong, a move which would have destroyed his career, but offered a deal: As long as the councilman supported any policies favorable to Emerald, he would not be exposed. As a second councilmember, Xi Chin, was also bribed by Emerald, this left the council largely under the magistrate's control. Only councilman Tsenten still offered strong resistance to Emerald's network.

As Emerald prepared his next moves, he ordered Fu Hong to sign a secret treaty which agreed to the annexation of Jasmine Island into the Earth Kingdom, and the councilman complied.

Fu Hong was utterly determined to defend the old standing of his family, and by extension his own position. This led him to become involved in illegal activities and subject himself to Emerald's blackmail. Despite realizing the consequences of his actions and feeling ashamed as well as insecure, he was unwilling to give up power even under these conditions.
